title: Chromatin-Associated Pea Apyrase psNTP9 Function as a DNA-Binding Regulatory Protein in Yeast and Arabidopsis.
authors: Wang, Huan; Slocum, Robert D; Cai, Xingbo; Clark, Greg; Roux, Stanley J
one_liner_zh: 该文研究豌豆apyrase psNTP9作为DNA结合蛋白在酵母和拟南芥中调控基因表达，结合ChIP-seq、EMSA和AlphaFold3建模，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: As reported in earlier work, when a pea apyrase, psNTP9 (PS), and a modified version of it, psNTP9-DM (DM), are expressed in Saccharomyces cerevisiae, they localize to nuclei, binding to largely non-overlapping promoter regions of chromatin. PS- and DM-expressing yeast also exhibit different expression profiles for potentially regulated target genes, consistent with observed phenotypes. In the present study, we use ChIP-seq assays to show that PS and DM also associate with largely different promoter regions of Arabidopsis genes, with similar non-overlapping expression profiles for potential target genes. Functional studies, using electrophoretic mobility shift assays (EMSA), verified PS-specific binding to yeast or plant promoter binding sites. DM binding to both heterologous dsDNA and to PS-specific binding site sequences was minimal. AlphaFold3 modeling of PS protein binding to a yeast PHM6 promoter sequence identified potential DNA-binding residues and a potential binding site motif (5'-(G/T)GG(G/T)A-3') that is also present in two Arabidopsis promoter binding sites. These novel findings extend the previously known functions of PS and other plant apyrases in the Golgi or extracellular matrix, and support their potential function as DNA-binding proteins that can regulate gene expression in both yeast and Arabidopsis.
abstract_zh: 如先前工作所述，当豌豆apyrase，psNTP9（PS），及其修饰版本psNTP9-DM（DM），在酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中表达时，它们定位于细胞核，结合到染色质上大部分不重叠的启动子区域。表达PS和DM的酵母在潜在调控靶基因的表达谱上也表现出差异，与观察到的表型一致。在本研究中，我们使用ChIP-seq实验表明，PS和DM也主要与拟南芥（Arabidopsis）基因的不同启动子区域结合，且潜在靶基因的表达谱同样不重叠。功能研究通过电泳迁移率变动分析（EMSA）验证了PS对酵母或植物启动子结合位点的特异性结合。DM对异源双链DNA及PS特异性结合位点序列的结合均极弱。AlphaFold3对PS蛋白与酵母PHM6启动子序列结合的建模，识别出潜在的DNA结合残基及一个潜在结合位点基序（5'-(G/T)GG(G/T)A-3'），该基序也存在于两个拟南芥启动子结合位点中。这些新发现扩展了PS及其他植物apyrase在高尔基体或细胞外基质中已知的功能，并支持其作为DNA结合蛋白在酵母和拟南芥中调控基因表达的潜在作用。
